info.description: Creates or updates a database backup long term retention policy
info.title: Azure SQL Database Backup Long Term Retention Policy

requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Sql/servers/{serverName}/databases/{databaseName}/backupLongTermRetentionPolicies
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
